name: p2r9-risk-delivery
user_authority: overnight autonomous direction authority 2026-09-18; operates under the R8-closure escape clause (trend/drawdown mechanism + more diversified shape); frequency variable NOT varied (all daily)

inherits_from.resolution_rule: runner verifies this sha256 before loading (fail-closed); inherits VERBATIM: u1_whitelist_frozen (1,168 codes), universe (U2/U3/U4/U5), preflight, fees, sizing base rule, execution_semantics base, warmup, segments, benchmarks B2/B4

hash_verification_policy: ALL data hashes below must ALSO be verified against disk manifests/files at runner start (fail-closed); R8 lesson: a hand-copied hash in config can have a typo (R8 fund_adj pin), disk truth + R7 pin are the cross-check

warmup.use: indicator lookback only (max 252 sessions for D252 rolling peak); no signals, no metrics

segments.isolation: single continuous simulation per config; segment metrics sliced from one equity curve; boundary mark-to-market carry; test slice evaluated once and only for val-passing configs
segments.history_note: dev consumed FOUR times (R6/R7/R8/R9, third reuse); val/test never used in any decision; false-positive risk on dev elevated by design iteration - val/test is the only real filter

signal.selection_freq: monthly (last trading session of each calendar month; inherited verbatim)
signal.momentum: inherited R7: R_k percentile-rank mean, ties by ts_code ascending
signal.signal_execution: selection at monthly close t, fills t+1 open; risk state computed EVERY session close t, traded t+1 open ONLY on state change

configs_grid.common: E_on=0.90 (saturates: N=3 -> 25%/leg = 75% effective; N=4 -> 22.5%/leg = 90% effective - higher on-exposure for N=4 disclosed as the diversification tradeoff)
configs_grid.hysteresis_semantics: state machine init ON; OFF when drawdown >= T; re-arm ON when drawdown from the SAME reference peak <= T/2 (PDD reference = all-time running peak, never resets; D-family reference = rolling-window peak, window keeps rolling); X1: OFF if either arm triggers, ON only when BOTH arms re-armed

C11.rearm: both arms re-armed (D60 arm <=0.04, PDD arm <=0.05)

mechanism_definitions.D60: 000300.SH close vs rolling 60-index-session peak (inclusive of t): dd = 1 - close/peak; OFF when dd >= T
mechanism_definitions.PDD: own-instance total equity marked at session close vs all-time running peak: dd = 1 - equity/peak; OFF when dd >= T; path-dependent per instance (strategy / B1(m) / B3prime each use own equity)
mechanism_definitions.X1: OFF if D60-arm OR PDD-arm condition; ON only when both re-armed

A1.requirement: bit-exact equity vs R8 run 20260918T021054-p2r8-daily-risk-d19a9c07 C01 (net and gross)

A2.requirement: bit-exact equity vs R8 run C09 (hysteresis code must not perturb the no-hysteresis path)

benchmarks.B1m_matched: same pool, equal weight, same monthly signal days, SAME mechanism DAILY exposure path with SAME hysteresis (PDD uses B1 own equity peak); idle cash carries forward; gross AND net disclosed, net primary

dev_all_required.2_excess_vs_B1m: dev net CAGR - B1(m) dev net CAGR >= +0.020 (annualized, pp)
dev_all_required.3_positive_years: net excess vs B1(m) > 0 in >= 4 of 5 dev calendar years
dev_all_required.4_drawdown: dev max drawdown <= 0.20 AND <= B1(m) dev max drawdown
dev_all_required.5_turnover: annual one-side (buy notional / mean equity) max over dev years <= 12.0; monthly sub-cap <= 6.0 (selection monthly; risk overlay buys count; NOT relaxed - solved by design: W2L churn headroom + hysteresis)
dev_all_required.6_concentration: dev net profit top-1 code share <= 40% AND top-3 <= 70% (N=4 configs additionally disclose top-4 share; gate stays top-1/top-3)
dev_all_required.7_vs_random: dev net CAGR >= mean(B3prime 20 seeds, same mechanism+hysteresis) + 0.010 (limited power, noted)
dev_all_required.8_execution: dev-window leg-level execution rate >= 0.95 (planned legs on dev signal days AND risk-state-change days; executed = filled/backfilled/rule-compliant cash slot/postponed-then-filled)

validation: val net CAGR excess vs B1(m) >= +0.010
net excess vs B1(m) > 0 in both 2021 and 2022
val max drawdown <= 0.20; turnover and concentration <= same dev-gate limits
gates.test_rule: test net excess vs B1(m) >= 0 AND test max drawdown <= 0.20 => P3 candidate; test run once, terminal
gates.advancement: dev all-pass -> highest net excess vs B1(m) advances (tie: lower id); at most 1; no all-pass -> record and close this line; STOP RULE: this line gets NO further rounds tonight regardless of outcome; val/test passer => P3 candidate, stop and report; failure => switch to G2/G3 preparation
